story.title: Our story
text: We all know the feeling: something breaks at home and it takes days to find someone reliable, available and fairly priced.
Qapinda simplifies that: you describe the job, professionals send offers, and you decide calmly based on ratings.
We build on the experience of our platform already running in Azerbaijan, and bring it to Hungary, tailored to local needs.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To make finding a trusted professional a two-minute task, not a worry, for both sides: the one who hires and the one who works.

items.d: Prices, ratings, terms: everything is where you expect to see it.
Verified profiles and real reviews, because trust is earned, not advertised.
We value the customer's time and the professional's craft.
What looks hard, we make easy.
Why is it so hard to find a good professional?
Real pros, real reviews, real jobs done.
We simplify and improve based on feedback.
We start in Budapest, then expand across the country.

hero.title: Good to know.
hero.lead: A few answers to help you get started.

items.a: You describe what you need, verified professionals in that category send offers, and you pick the best one based on price and ratings.

items.q: Does it cost anything to post a request?
items.a: No. Posting a request and viewing offers is free for customers, and the choice is always yours.

items.q: How do I choose the right professional?
items.a: Compare offer prices, availability, experience and past customers' reviews. If you have questions, the pro can get in touch.

items.q: Can I offer my own services?
items.a: Yes! You can sign up as a professional, choose your categories and receive job leads. We'll let you know when registration opens.

items.q: When does Qapinda launch in Hungary?
items.a: Soon, starting in Budapest. Leave your email and we'll tell you the moment the door opens.

items.q: How do you handle my data?
items.a: We only process the data we need, in line with GDPR. Details are in our privacy policy.
